description.value: Rust Wine Co. is a small-lot winery on the Golden Mile Bench — BC's first designated sub-appellation — sourcing from old-vine vineyards planted as far back as 1968. The tasting room offers sweeping views over the Black Sage Bench toward Osoyoos, and a restored 19th-century bunkhouse relocated from a silver mine serves as a unique vacation rental on the property. Weekly live music events through the season make it an animated stop along the South Okanagan winery route.
